title: Identification of Macrophage Polarization-Related Biomarkers in Multiple Myeloma Using Integrated Bioinformatics.
snippet: Multiple myeloma (MM) is an incurable hematologic neoplasm with heterogeneous prognosis. Within the bone marrow microenvironment, macrophage polarization (MP) contributes to immune remodeling and may influence disease progression, yet MP-related prognostic biomarkers remain insufficiently characterized.
